2.  Arguable questions are raised, hence the above Writ Petition is admitted. As far as interim relief is concerned, we are not inclined to grant any interim relief in the light of the orders passed in other Writ Petitions in relation to a similar case already pending in this JULY 08, 2024 Utkarsh 22.wp.862.2024.doc Court which also challenged the complete ban of 1 year inter alia on Pan Masala.
3. In the facts of this case and considering the impugned prohibition order, we are not inclined to grant any interim relief. 
4. This order will be digitally signed by the Private Secretary/ Personal Assistant of this Court. All concerned will act on production by fax or email of a digitally signed copy of this order.
